Interface RValue

All Known Implementing Classes:
RValue.Int, RValue.List, RValue.Logical, RValue.Null, RValue.Num, RValue.Other, RValue.Raw, RValue.Str
public sealed interface RValue permits RValue.Null, RValue.Logical, RValue.Int, RValue.Num, RValue.Str, RValue.Raw, RValue.List, RValue.Other
An R object as Java data (a copy). Read with doubles(), ints(), strings(), booleans(), bytes(), firstDouble(), firstString(), elements(), matrix() and create with RValue.of(...), listOf(...), dataFrame(...), factor(...).

The types as records: The vector types of R map to one record each; the attributes names, dim, dimnames, class, levels and row.names are kept (other attributes are not transferred).

NA: R's own values are kept (integer and logical: NA_INTEGER, double: the NA bit pattern, see isNA(double), character: null).
